definitions.explanation: Having a pure, fresh quality characteristic of youth or inexperience. Used positively to describe someone who is charmingly new to something.

examples.japanese: {初々|ういうい}しい⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧。
{初々|ういうい}しい⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だった。

⟦{入学|にゅうがく}した→入学する：01851_nyuugakusuru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{初々|ういうい}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: Seeing the fresh-faced students who have just enrolled reminds me of my own youth.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adnominal: {初々|ういうい}しい + noun
- Adverbial: {初々|ういうい}しく
- Predicate: {初々|ういうい}しい

USAGE:
Always positive in connotation. Used to describe the charming freshness of someone new to a role, relationship, or stage of life. Often used by older people looking at younger people with warm nostalgia.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初々|ういうい}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: fresh, youthful appearance
- {初々|ういうい}しい⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: innocent smile
- {初々|ういうい}しい⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧: fresh-faced newcomer
- {初々|ういうい}しい⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧: a new couple (still in the honeymoon phase)
